description: Read-only directory for explicit shop-name questions, near a US ZIP code or served market. Returns shop identifiers, addresses and storefront URLs. A listing proves no product stock, price, delivery or checkout eligibility.

market.description: Market key, e.g. san-antonio-tx. Used when no zip is given.

name.description: Shop name or part of it, e.g. "Cheeky Monkey".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code: searches the shops within 15 miles of it first, then the national list.

name: find_stores

partial.description: True when not every listed shop could be compared.

alias_store_ids.description: Other store ids JENNi folded into this same physical shop. Display only.

url.description: The shop's page on the storefront.

title: Find a shop by name
